instances: Eight pre-generated independent internal confirmation bases, including 40x20 and 50x50; never the project final test.
Holm_family: Two frozen HV treatment/control contrasts; AUC, diversity and runtime reported with multiplicity limitations.
acceptance: Positive paired base-bootstrap lower bound for HV and AUC, gains in at least 6/8 base means on each, genetic diversity ratio >=.90 and mean time ratio <=1.30. No changes based on confirmation.
timing_order: Rotate methods per case. Replay guidance must follow its adaptive control; all other ordering remains counterbalanced.
stop: Stop after reproducible improvement meeting these gates, or on original experimental FE/time cap. If incomplete, report that confirmation is incomplete and do not silently relax gates.
